aiConsent.title: Use AI to estimate your meals?
aiConsent.body: To estimate nutrition, Kallo sends the meal descriptions you type, the label photos you scan and your ingredient searches to Google’s Gemini AI (Vertex AI on Google Cloud).
aiConsent.training: Google doesn’t use them to train its models. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
